report.method: Vite fixture imports the real public UTreeview and ULocaleProvider through src/ui/index.ts and exercises the source in Chromium.

checks.name: single-leaf defaults, openOnClick inference, and selected alias priority
checks.details: The tree defaults to a single-leaf strategy, selectable branches open on click, selected wins over modelValue, and selection emits both array aliases.

checks.name: multiple open strategy adds ancestors
checks.details: The public ref open method emits the opened item and its ancestor path through update:opened.

checks.name: complete-tree multiple cascade compatibility
checks.details: itemsRegistration=props keeps complete-tree cascade output; default render registration is covered by tree-registration-protocols.

checks.name: branch strategy and mixed state
checks.details: Explicit branch strategy returns its selected leaf plus its indeterminate branch ancestor.

checks.name: custom item selectors and itemProps disabled
checks.details: Function itemProps, dotted itemTitle, itemValue and itemChildren selectors are consumed; disabled items keep DOM/ARIA state and cannot be focused or selected.

checks.name: returnObject and custom valueComparator
checks.details: A comparator matches cloned model objects by key, and emitted selected arrays contain the original item objects.

checks.name: activated is opt-in and emits arrays
checks.details: activatable defaults false; single-independent emits an empty array to cancel an already active controlled scalar value.

checks.name: disabled and readonly guards
checks.details: Top-level disabled removes row interaction; readonly keeps the row but blocks selection.

checks.name: search filterKeys and customFilter
checks.details: Custom filtering uses the selected nested key and reveals matching descendants with their ancestor path.

checks.name: keyboard sibling expansion and disabled navigation
checks.details: * expands every enabled sibling branch and End focuses the last enabled rendered treeitem.

checks.name: locale-aware RTL keyboard model
checks.details: Arabic locale reverses horizontal expand/focus and collapse behavior.

checks.name: lazy loader return and mutation protocols
checks.details: Returned child arrays and in-place item.children mutation both rebuild the public tree.

checks.name: lazy errors reach the title slot
checks.details: Rejected loadChildren calls clear pending state and expose the error to the existing title slot scope.

checks.name: stale lazy response invalidation
checks.details: Replacing an item with the same key invalidates the in-flight result and clears the pending marker.

checks.name: unmount lazy cleanup
checks.details: Unmounting with a pending lazy request does not apply its result or produce a browser error.

limits: Chromium browser renderer only; no Electron renderer acceptance is claimed.
No full project build, full test suite, or visual design acceptance was run.
The fixture validates local source through the public entry; it does not validate the compiled package bundle.

report.method: Vite dev server imports the real public UTreeview from src/ui/index.ts and drives it in installed Chrome.

checks.name: optional items default to an empty tree
checks.details: The public component mounts without an items prop and renders no rows.

checks.name: filter modes invoke raw item callbacks
checks.details: Union keeps default or custom-key matches; intersection requires the custom-key match and a default match, and both callbacks receive original item objects.

checks.name: ignoreAccents honors query and target sides in the public component
checks.details: Target folding matches both spellings for an unaccented query; query-only mode leaves the accented target unmatched.

checks.name: noFilter ignores search without expanding branches
checks.details: All root rows remain available while descendants stay collapsed.

checks.name: openAll expands initial and newly added branches only when opened is uncontrolled
checks.details: An explicit empty opened model remains closed, returnObject values stay compatible, and uncontrolled openAll follows later data additions.

checks.name: initial openAll can start loadChildren during setup
checks.details: The immediate openAll watcher loads the initial empty branch and renders its resolved child without a setup-time initialization error.

checks.name: item and detail slots retain title scope and emit ID paths
checks.details: Prepend, append, toggle, title, item, and actions slots render; open events carry click events and selection events carry the original root-to-item ID path.

checks.name: itemType renders divider and subheader rows as presentation content
checks.details: Only item entries participate in treeitem focus and selection semantics.

checks.name: readonly and disabled guards suppress selection and opening callbacks
checks.details: Readonly blocks selection; disabled blocks branch interaction and its click event.

checks.name: loader slot tracks the existing lazy-load lifecycle
checks.details: Opening an empty branch invokes loadChildren, reports loading through the loader slot, then renders loaded children.

report.method: A Chromium fixture imports UOverlay, UMenu and UiDialog from the public index and checks computed browser geometry and native positioning behavior.

checks.name: public Overlay and Menu consume dimensions, contentClass and connected target geometry
checks.details: Selector and HTMLElement targets place the open content at target bounds plus configured offsets; all six dimension props reach live content styles.

checks.name: public Dialog consumes point target, dimensions and block scroll strategy
checks.details: A [x,y] target and explicit connected position compute the expected fixed geometry; body lock is visible while open.

checks.name: target replacement and public updateLocation refresh all three components
checks.details: Overlay selector, Menu HTMLElement and Dialog point targets can be replaced while open, and Dialog ref updateLocation remeasures the new point.

checks.name: target ResizeObserver and viewport resize recompute connected placement
checks.details: Target dimension changes update Menu alignment; window resize keeps all open connected surfaces inside the configured viewport margin.

checks.name: scroll strategies preserve none versus reposition behavior
checks.details: Menu follows a scrolled target under reposition; standalone Overlay stays put under none until its public updateLocation is called.

checks.name: legacy location=anchor keeps the four-pixel offset and anchor class
checks.details: Without locationStrategy, the historical anchor alias remains connected to its activator with a 4px main-axis offset.

checks.name: public target aliases parent and cursor resolve live browser anchors
checks.details: External activator selector resolves its parent HTMLElement; slot activator click coordinates resolve the cursor point.

checks.name: default DOM Menu keeps bottom-start placement and five-pixel gap
checks.details: Connected placement preserves the established 5px gap without native popover anchoring.

checks.name: explicit static positioning handles Overlay/Menu/Dialog locations
checks.details: Static mode keeps known Menu placement native when defaulted and applies viewport edge positioning when explicitly requested.

checks.name: default Overlay remains centered when no location is supplied
checks.details: The default class and native dialog bounds center in the viewport.

checks.name: Dialog center and end placements remain available
checks.details: The default center dialog remains viewport centered; placement=end remains a full-height end-aligned drawer.

checks.name: connected placement respects CSS zoom
checks.details: Target client geometry is converted into the content coordinate space at 125% zoom.

checks.name: end Dialog stays inside a narrow zoomed viewport
checks.details: Default drawer width and full height remain bounded at 390px/125%.

checks.name: fullscreen overrides explicit dimensions at CSS zoom
checks.details: Fullscreen Overlay and Dialog fill the visual viewport at 390px/125%.

checks.name: menu closeOnBack=false leaves navigation in control

checks.name: lazy content is removed after the leave transition

checks.name: noAutoScroll suppresses selected-item virtual scrolling

checks.name: eager and block policies survive close

checks.name: scrollStrategy=close responds to page scroll
